description: Explicit general relation filter/group-key compilation experiment over the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Existing workloads retain their comparison schedules; new queries cover combined nullable group keys and WHERE, with an unsupported text predicate control.

workloads.name: aggregate
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE bucket = $1

workloads.name: aggregate_argument
workloads.sql: SELECT sum((score * 3 + bucket) / (bucket + 1)) FROM items WHERE bucket >= $1

workloads.name: aggregate_many_groups
workloads.sql: SELECT score % 100, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY score % 100 ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: group
workloads.sql: SELECT bucket, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

workloads.name: aggregate_multi
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*), count(score), min(score), max(score), sum(score), bit_xor(score) FROM items

workloads.name: general_where_keys
workloads.sql: SELECT bucket % 3, CASE WHEN score < $1 THEN NULL ELSE score % 7 END, count(*), sum(score) FROM items WHERE bucket >= 2 GROUP BY bucket % 3, CASE WHEN score < $1 THEN NULL ELSE score % 7 END ORDER BY 1, 2

workloads.name: general_text_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label >= 'row5'
